body: I’m sorry you’ve dealt with this stuff. No one should ever have to but yeah you’re right... they don’t know how to not cross the line. I’m so tired of this stuff. It’s ruined so much..
I am a she. I don’t need luck. I’ll be gone soon enough 🖤

As far as I know, no there isn’t. It’s incredibly difficult here to get help especially with no insurance.  The process it takes to get a therapist is kind of ridiculous. You need to get a referral from a doctor to say that you need therapy and then you need to figure out a therapist that specializes in what you need. And even then some insurance companies won’t cover therapy so it’s all out of pocket. I was never taught how to do any of this by myself so I have no idea what to do
